title: Analysis of Ongoing Ousaban Attacks Targeting the Iberian Peninsula
content: In May 2026, an attack campaign targeting banking users in Spain and Portugal was identified involving the Ousaban banking Trojan. The malware, previously active in Brazil, spreads through phishing PDFs that redirect victims to malicious webpages performing environment checks to ensure targets are located in Spain or Portugal. The attack chain involves VBS scripts downloading steganographic... This pulse includes 32 indicators of compromise (IOCs). Targeted industries: Finance. Associated malware: Ousaban, Metamorfo - S0455, Casbaneiro.

title: Iran-Nexus Disseminates MarkiRAT Surveillance Tool
content: TAG-182, an Iran-nexus threat cluster, is conducting surveillance operations targeting Iranian citizens both domestically and abroad using MarkiRAT malware. The group distributes fake Android applications masquerading as VPN services and media players through social media platforms, particularly Instagram. Following Iran's partial internet restoration in May 2026 after an 88-day shutdown, these... This pulse includes 80 indicators of compromise (IOCs). Associated malware: MarkiRAT - S0652, FurBall, DCHSpy.

title: How a single ScreenConnect incident exposed a massive campaign
content: A massive campaign distributes malicious installer archives hosted on spoofed websites masquerading as popular software like OBS Studio, DNS Jumper, DS4Windows, and Bandicam. Over 90 domain names localized across 10 languages were discovered. The malicious archives bundle a legitimate Microsoft-signed install.exe binary with a rogue install.res.1033.dll library deployed via DLL sideloading. This... This pulse includes 129 indicators of compromise (IOCs). Associated malware: AsyncRAT, ScreenConnect.

title: Tax Season, Open Season: Phishing and Malware Campaigns Targeting Indian Taxpayers
content: A sophisticated malware campaign is targeting Indian taxpayers during filing season by impersonating the Income Tax Department. Attackers distribute fake penalty notices via WhatsApp from unknown or compromised accounts, using forged Office Memorandums citing legitimate tax law sections and creating 72-hour deadlines to induce panic.
